notes.title: MAC SUPPORT - Update notes for 29 July 2023
notes.content:
[h2]MAC SUPPORT ADDED[/h2]
- 2.5% of Steam users are using Mac devices according to random article on the internet. So I didn't want to exempt them from playing this epic game! :)

[h2]16:10 RATIO SUPPORT ADDED[/h2]
- Most Mac devices support a 16:10 screen ratio, so naturally, we had to adapt the game to support these resolutions. 
- [b]This also applies to Windows gamers.[/b]

notes.title: LOCALIZATION UPDATE - Update notes for 20 July 2023
notes.content:
[h2]Added:[/h2]
- Mr. Mat Hematic now supports 9 new languages besides English
[olist]
[*] Azərbaycanca
[*] Español
[*] Deutsche
[*] Português
[*] Français
[*] Polski
[*] Italiano
[*] Türkçe
[*] Pусский
[/olist]
We still want to add more language support to the game. If your language is not on the list, you can contact us on our Discord server, and with your help it will be done.

[b][i]Major missing languages (please contact us on Discord if you can help us with these languages):[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/WrhPvrrCQB]https://discord.gg/WrhPvrrCQB[/url]


[i]If you encounter any bugs/errors regarding new languages, please let us know on our Discord server.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456500/Parallel_Pals/
